audited_resolutions.explanation: The locked Gate 0 inventory contains 4 weapons, 9 armour pieces, 5 foods and 5 potions. The master document's repeated total of 18 omitted the five in-place potions even though Phase 8 requires them to retain IDs.
audited_resolutions.light_armor_skill_explanation: Live Armourer recipes use Smithing for Heavy armour and Tailoring for Light armour. Gate 5 corrects the Gate 4 one-skill station map and preserves that established split.
audited_resolutions.meadow_berries_explanation: The live Berry Bush requirement of 3 conflicted with the locked level-1 Linen Cloth recipe. Gate 5 applies a lower-only requirement correction to 1 so the tier-1 dependency graph is reachable without weakening or replacing the unchanged recipe.
